headline: Coca-Cola Europacific Partners Flags Cost Pressures While Maintaining Outlook
summary: Bottler Coca-Cola Europacific Partners highlighted ongoing cost pressures in its operations while confirming its existing full-year financial outlook.
why: Input cost inflation and margin commentary from major consumer staples bottlers provide insights into pricing power and consumer demand trends.
